“the stakes for our company has never been higher” >>> “the stakes for our company have never been higher”

“the federal goverment” >>> “the federal government”

“matters more then ever” >>> “matters more than ever”

“has three cosponsors on the committee, Senators Okafor and Lindqvist” >>> [CHECK: three cosponsors are claimed, but only two are named]

“but it's definitions are broad” >>> “but its definitions are broad”

“its central principal” >>> “its central principle”

“the bill's enforcment regime” >>> “the bill's enforcement regime”

“would directly effect every company” >>> “would directly affect every company”

“Senator Whitfield (R-OH)” / “Senator Whitfield (R-OK)” >>> [CHECK: Whitfield’s state designation is inconsistent]

“narrows the registry in Section 5” >>> “narrows the registry in Section 4”

“keeps the $10 million daily civil penalty” >>> [CHECK: Section 5 is earlier described as imposing a maximum civil penalty of $1 million per day]

“Senator Grant, who's support” >>> “Senator Grant, whose support”

“the amendment's changes is modest” >>> “the amendment's changes are modest”

“of the committees 28 members” >>> “of the committee’s 28 members”

“13 are yes or leaning yes, 10 are no or leaning no, and 6 are undecided” >>> [CHECK: these categories total 29 members, not 28]

“The undecided senators are Chen, Ellis, Alvarez, Pike, and Barlow.” >>> [CHECK: only five senators are listed, although the preceding sentence says six are undecided; Ames is also later described as not having made a final decision]

“Thursday, October 14” >>> “Thursday, October 15”

“after the September 23 hearing” / “The committee's hearing on the risks of advanced AI occured on September 30” >>> [CHECK: confirm whether these refer to separate hearings; otherwise the hearing date is inconsistent]

“in a seperate interview” >>> “in a separate interview”

“The list of undecided senators, along with their staff contacts, are attached.” >>> “The list of undecided senators, along with their staff contacts, is attached.”

“Commerce Commitee markup” >>> “Commerce Committee markup”

“the week November 16” >>> “the week of November 16”

“advanced AI occured” >>> “advanced AI occurred”

“within two years” >>> [CHECK: Section 6 is earlier described as requiring an international agreement within 18 months]

“a close compliment to S. 2817” >>> “a close complement to S. 2817”

“with the the offices” >>> “with the offices”

“call there senators” >>> “call their senators”

“you should recieve” >>> “you should receive”

“Our six regional policy leads” / “Each of our five regional policy leads” >>> [CHECK: the number of regional policy leads is inconsistent]
